enchantments.tooltip: +4 Enhancement Bonus: +4 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Anarchic 3: This weapon is chaotic and used to undermine the righteous, dealing an additional 3d6 chaos damage on each hit. This effect makes the weapon chaotic aligned. (Lawful characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.)
Vorpal: Passive: +0.5[W] damage dice.On Vorpal Hit: If your target has fewer than 1000 Hit Points, they are instantly slain. If your target has above 1000 Hit Points, they take 100 damage.
Incite +65: +65% Enhancement bonus to increased threat generation from melee damage
Intimidate +14: Passive: +14 Competence bonus to the Intimidate skill.
